business: NORTHLINE (working name): an online-only everyday clothing brand
why_not: I already have a hoodie I wear every week and I buy from Nike, Uniqlo and Carhartt because I know what I'm getting. A brand I've never heard of at $78 for a hoodie is asking me to take a risk with no reason to.
$38 for a tee is double what I pay at Uniqlo or H&M, and I've never heard of Northline. I'm not putting money on a brand with no real customer reviews or photos I can check.
$38 for a tee is like four or five Shein tees for me, and I make about $13k a year. Nice fabric sounds good but I don't spend that much on one basic piece.
$38 for a tee is way more than I pay at H&M or Uniqlo, and even with 15% off it's still over $32 for one shirt. On my budget I'd rather get three tees for that.
